summary: Module 5 CONTEXT micro-exercise (severity classification). (1) Broken images: SEV2 for an e-commerce site where images are the product -- customers cannot evaluate what they are buying, core revenue path visibly degraded, needs a dedicated responder and leadership update; SEV3 for an internal tool where it is cosmetic. Context decides. (2) Cross-user private data via URL parameter change: SEV1, unconditionally -- this is an access-control breach (IDOR class), active data exposure with regulatory implications (breach notification, privacy law), requires waking people and external communication; it is the most severe class regardless of request volume. (3) Weekly analytics report delayed 2 hours: SEV3 -- reports are delayed, not lost, no real-time user impact; track and fix in business hours; would escalate to SEV2 only if it were real-time billing or revenue-affecting with SLA breach.
